name: FreePats Clarinet
description: Recorded clarinet performed by Kaili Dence and recorded by Tyler Dence for the FreePats project; processed and mapped by Roberto.

license.author: Kaili Dence (performer); Tyler Dence (recording engineer); Roberto (looping and sound-bank modifications)
license.notes: CC0 1.0. The FreePats readme credits Kaili Dence as performer, Tyler Dence as recording engineer, and Roberto for loops and sample modifications. Original samples were recorded with an Audio-Technica AT873R. Mapped range MIDI 45-91 with nine looped source notes.
